statement: A quote binds the taker to nothing: it reserves only the maker's give, takes none of the taker's room and is no clause of the signed body, so a maker cannot lock the taker's funds or fill a proof body with clauses the taker never saw. At most 4 quotes per maker are open in an Account (too_many_quotes). The taker's first fill is its acceptance: the quote becomes an offer, a clause of its own, and the taker's want is reserved against the taker only if its RCPAN still holds (insufficient_capacity otherwise, the quote unchanged); a fill that takes everything never becomes a clause. The Arrival cell holds the one-Account half: a quote reserves only the maker's give and is no clause of the signed body, the taker's first fill reserves its whole remaining want only if RCPAN holds, and a fill that takes everything never becomes a clause; the cap of 4 quotes per maker (too_many_quotes) and the 33rd clause of a first fill (too_many_holds) are on no page (the menu has one quote per maker, at most two clauses).
source: Arthur 10-01 02:53 (D3: two-party swap inside an Account); coordinator 10-01 10:17 (swap consent); plan/swap-onchain.md
